replay.undetermined_rule: A record's outcome under the new code follows from its recorded model outputs when every decision the workflow acts on is unchanged: the parsed analysis, the parsed code, every rubric check, the test admission problems and the review verdict. Then every later prompt and the disposition are the same. When one of them changes (for example a rubric check, which decides whether a correction is requested and is quoted in the correction prompt), the later model outputs are unknown, so the outcome is undetermined until the arm is run again.
